children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on WPIL

WPIL reported a weak 2QFY27 performance with a miss on our expectations – consolidated revenue/EBITDA came in at Rs3.5bn/Rs472mn, declining 17%/41% yoy. EBITDA margin declined by 550bps yoy at 13.3%. Products revenue at Rs2.1bn (-14.7% yoy) and Projects revenue at Rs1.4bn (-19.9% yoy). The subdued performance in the products division was due to deferral of large orders which is expected to normalize in 2H. Projects division saw lumpiness in revenue booking on the international front and slower execution of JJM orders on the domestic front. Order backlog at end-2QFY27 stands at Rs51bn (47:53 mix between domestic and international). Despite the weak operating performance, NWC days improved by 21 days to 217, while cash flow from operations improved to Rs1.1bn in 1HFY27 (vs -Rs986mn in 1HFY26).
We revise down our revenue/PAT estimates on average by 17%/26% over FY26- 29. We maintain BUY on WPIL, while cutting our TP by ~15% to Rs550 from Rs650, based on 20x Sep-28E EPS.
